tips.text: Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Buy extra Handle relics; it is the Rare in every one that carries it.
Refine the Rare relics to Radiant but leave the Blueprint relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds.
Join a Radiant radshare squad for the Rare relics.
Pick a teammate's identical reward on the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
